column1: # Accepted GPL-only files of the contribs (check-no-gpl.sh, section H).
# PACKAGE-GLOB <TAB> PATH-REGEX (relative to the package directory) <TAB> justification
# Intentionally empty. Section H already tells apart, from facts read in the build tree:
# a GPL-only file that was not compiled (no object file; this covers tests, tools and
# the FFmpeg code that --disable-gpl leaves out), a file compiled but whose object is in
# no installed static library (programs, tests: compared by object content, SHA-256),
# and a file compiled and linked (refused). Add a line here only for a file that IS
# compiled and linked and whose license you have verified is acceptable (for example a
# dual license read in the file), with that fact as the justification.
